title: Marvin Harrison: I support Jacoby Brissett, but can't build chemistry while he holds out

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Marvin Harrison: I support Jacoby Brissett, but can't build chemistry while he holds out
sources.description: Cardinals quarterback Jacoby Brissett is sitting out voluntary offseason practices while he seeks a new contract, which means he's not building chemistry with wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr.
